title: ProjectEnervate
description: A ProjectE addon that rebalances EMC progression so that resource gathering and mining, and exploration remain useful throughout the game.
body:
# **ProjectEnervate**
The primary objected of this mod is to nerf projectE for a more down to ground progression, while blocking game breaking EMC loops and allowing every item to have EMC - even ores.


## **This mod is not officially supported or endorsed by ProjectE**.
This is an unofficial [ProjectE](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/projecte) addon.



## Core features that allow this

The primary feature is adaptive EMC value that changes the value of an item based on how it was created - this works for all vanilla item conversions and some mods are supported.

![10 clay being converted to one emerald - the emeralds EMC is as much as the 10 clay](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1ab6a46632de594957fd074f59ad8545c023dca7.png)

Unsuported modded crafting methods will result in void items to avoid any EMC loops _(example: with a sifting mod, you could previously get gravel, and sift for diamons resulting in infinite EMC!. If however, sifting were supported, then the resulting diamond would only be as valued as the gravel was)._

![A diamon that is of no value](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d6174eb79a23d74e9644c61593e558a292eb200a.png)

To encurage traveling and multi-resource gathering rather then farming one resource, Celestial value has been added.

![A constellation of stars](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5721d92013613dbd19498d470483d97a21b95666_0.webp)

Depending on these celestial bodies, the value of natural resource waver greatly - iron could be nearly as valuable as diamonds! 

![Showing iron being almost as valuable as diamonds](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3c13573ca926ecb4074239081587a28e0de1e625.png)

Use the Celestial Scope or Celestial Tracker for more advanced star details!

![Celestial scope and Celestial Map](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5ba24e089818fffa0595bda2740f788f89c20aa1.png)


No more unlimited EMC!
Klein stars have been reworked to be the sole battery of EMC - without them you cant store EMC

![EMC storage is full](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2bd6159a971751e6cdb3eb410c9176e50660623e.png)

Any one of these features can be disabled in the config in case you feel its been _too_ nerfed for your liking.

## Development
As this mod addon is still in early development, please [report any bugs on github](https://github.com/dpdurczok/ProjectEnervate/issues).
